annotation.bound_parties_text: The chapter binds owners of fully autonomous vehicles, persons operating vehicles with automated driving systems, applicants for title/registration, state agencies and political subdivisions, and the Transportation Commission.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: no state agency, or political subdivision may prohibit the operation of fully autonomous vehicles, automated driving systems, or on-demand autonomous vehicle networks
annotation.robot_provision_quote: CHAPTER 32-41 AUTOMATED MOTOR VEHICLES ... Source: SL 2024, ch 122, § 1.
